title: Insulin Pump Program Delivery, Return and Hold Limits
content:
Service limits of the Insulin Pump Program for carrier problems, returns, defects and program holds.

## Carrier, damage, return and defect limits

| Tier | Carrier trace period | Courtesy reships per 12 months | Damage report window | Return window | Restocking fee | Opened supplies returnable | Signature on pump delivery | Defect report window |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Insulin Pump Self-Pay Program | 3 business days | 1 | 7 days | 30 days | 15% | No | Yes | 30 days |
| Insulin Pump Commercial HMO Program | 3 business days | 1 | 7 days | 30 days | 0% | No | Yes | 30 days |
| Insulin Pump Commercial PPO Program | 3 business days | 1 | 7 days | 30 days | 0% | No | Yes | 30 days |
| Insulin Pump Medicare Advantage Program | 3 business days | 1 | 7 days | 30 days | 0% | No | Yes | 30 days |
| Insulin Pump Original Medicare Program | 3 business days | 1 | 7 days | 30 days | 0% | No | Yes | 30 days |
| Insulin Pump Medicaid Program | 3 business days | 1 | 7 days | 30 days | 0% | No | Yes | 30 days |

## Program holds

| Tier | Inpatient hold required | Longest hold before administrative closure |
|---|---|---|
| Insulin Pump Self-Pay Program | No | 180 days |
| Insulin Pump Commercial HMO Program | Yes | 60 days |
| Insulin Pump Commercial PPO Program | Yes | 90 days |
| Insulin Pump Medicare Advantage Program | Yes | 90 days |
| Insulin Pump Original Medicare Program | Yes | 90 days |
| Insulin Pump Medicaid Program | Yes | 60 days |

## Meaning of each limit

- **Carrier trace period** — in business days (Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays) after the carrier's expected delivery date, after which an undelivered package is declared lost in transit.
- **Courtesy reships per 12 months** — the number of no-charge courtesy reships per program for packages the carrier shows as delivered but the customer did not receive, counted over the rolling 12 months ending on the reship date.
- **Damage report window** — for reporting a package damaged in transit, in calendar days counted from the carrier delivery date.
- **Return window** — for requesting the return of unopened, sealed items, in calendar days counted from the carrier delivery date of the shipment.
- **Restocking fee** — withheld from the credit for an accepted return, as a percent of the amount the customer paid for the returned units; an integer percent.
- **Opened supplies returnable** — whether opened medical supplies may be returned for credit.
- **Signature on pump delivery** — whether the carrier must obtain the customer's signature on delivery of a pump (E0784) package; supply packages are delivered on carrier scan.
- **Defect report window** — for reporting supplies that were defective as shipped (wrong item, expired, damaged sterile packaging, recalled lot), in calendar days counted from the carrier delivery date.
- **Inpatient hold required** — whether shipments must be held while the customer is an inpatient in a hospital or skilled nursing facility, because the payer does not pay home supplies during a covered stay.
- **Longest hold** — the longest time a program may remain on hold, in calendar days counted from the hold start date, before it is closed administratively.

*Illustration (hypothetical):* a self-pay customer who paid $100.00 for units later accepted back as unopened would see the 15% restocking fee, $15.00, withheld from the credit; on any insured tier the fee is 0%.
